flags.title: Stone and Strand `SS-MIA`: 14K Spec vs 10K Image Alt Contradiction + Non-Returnable Final Sale
flags.detail: Live PDP specifications state 'Gold Karat: 14K' while gallery image alt attributes state 'Stone and Strand 10K Yellow Gold The Mia Diamond Ring'. At 50% off ($925 vs $1,850), both SS-MIA and SS-RITA ($780, 60% off) are explicitly 'Final sale and non-returnable' — failing Checklist Rule #12 (never buy when return after independent XRF check is disallowed).
flags.action: Do not purchase Final Sale jewelry online without return rights; require written 14K vs 10K clarification before any full-price order.

flags.title: Factory Direct Jewelry `FDJ-GR0001`: Ultra-Light `1.25 g` Displayed Weight vs `1.37 ctw` Diamonds & `1.8/5` BBB Score
flags.detail: Although FDJ-GR0001 explicitly states 'Made with solid gold. Never plated.' and 'Karat stamped inside the band.', its default displayed weight is 'Weight:1.25 Grams' alongside 1.37 carats of lab diamonds (0.274 g gem mass). If gross weight, net 14K gold is only 0.976 g ($73.67 melt at $4,024.45/oz) — extreme bending/snapping risk matching BBB complaints (Not Accredited, 1.8/5 across 5 reviews, 11 complaints, 20% alteration restocking fee).
flags.action: Treat verbal 'solid gold + stamped' claims as insufficient whenever gram mass is ultra-low or BBB complaints report snapped shanks.

flags.title: Missing Metal Weight in Grams on Mainstream Settings (`Blue Nile`, `Brilliant Earth`, `Mejuri`, `Zales`, `Stone & Strand`, `Menē` PDP)
flags.detail: Most mass-market engagement ring PDPs omit gram weight entirely (`weight_g: null`). Under the No-Hallucinations Policy, missing weights are never estimated from band width.
flags.action: Request size-specific metal gram weight in writing from customer support before checkout, then verify on an independent jeweler's calibrated scale upon arrival.

flags.title: Sarraf Jewelry Inc. (`SAR-*`): Internal Policy Contradictions & Size-10 Weight Benchmark Variance
flags.detail: Sarraf publishes explicit '14K Solid Gold', 'US$' prices, and separate 'Approximate Metal Weight' in grams, and holds an A+ Accredited BBB profile since 1998. However, live audit caught: (1) product tab allows engraved ring returns less $25 fee while /about-sarraf/ says 'non-engraved items'; (2) warranty deductible reads '$100 or 10%' on diamond ring pages vs '$50 or 5%' on 10K bands; (3) SAR-144773's 13.40 g weight ($1,011.39 melt = 74.3% of US$1,362) is benchmarked at ring size 10, weighing less in smaller sizes (10.1–10.2 g reported in buyer reviews; BBB customer reviews 2.33/5).
flags.action: Confirm exact gram weight for your ring size in writing before ordering, avoid engraving before XRF/scale inspection, and pay by credit card.

flags.title: Gross Item Weight vs Stone-Free Metal Weight (`AG-SAPPHIRE-RING`, `AV-BRIDGE`, `AV-CLEAN`)
flags.detail: Automic Gold stone-free bands (`AG-COFFIN-RING` 6.1g, `AG-24K` 11.0g) give pure metal weight, whereas gemstone rings (`AG-SAPPHIRE-RING` 1.2g) include gemstone mass, and Auvere 22K rings (`AV-BRIDGE` 5–6.1g, `AV-CLEAN` 2.8–3.7g) publish size ranges rather than a single size weight.
flags.action: Use the gemstone carat deduction input (`1 ct = 0.200 g`) in the calculator when weighing set rings; never plug gross stone+metal mass directly into pure alloy melt.

flags.title: Zales Currency Symbol Without Explicit ISO `USD` & `Z-20046552` Unlabeled Dual Amounts
flags.detail: Live 2026-10-23 fetch confirmed Z-20303279 ($979.30 / $1,399.00) and Z-20301172 ($769.30 / $1,099.00) restored 'Discounted Price' / 'Original Price was' labels, while Z-20046552 still displays unlabeled '$909.30  $1,299.00 30% Off' and all four omit an explicit 'USD' string.
flags.action: Keep Z-20046552 price unassigned (`null`) rather than guessing which unlabeled amount applies, and verify checkout currency in USD.

flags.title: Zero Physical XRF or Calibrated Scale Assays Performed Remotely
flags.detail: Every record in GOLD2 reflects primary web document verification as of 2026-10-23. Seller text and stamps can still be inaccurate on a delivered piece.
flags.action: Upon arrival — before wearing, resizing, or removing tags — weigh the ring on an independent local jeweler's gram scale and verify karat purity via non-destructive XRF.
